scripts.deps: mkdir -p /tmp/pnpm-store && pnpm config set store-dir /tmp/pnpm-store &&rm -rf node_modules && rm -rf pnpm-lock.yaml && rm -rf ~/.pnpm-store && pnpm store prune && pnpm install --no-prefer-frozen-lockfile
scripts.example: pnpm build && pnpm -F @examples/studio generate && pnpm -F @examples/layered generate
scripts.lint: pnpm lint:md && pnpm lint:text && pnpm lint:spell && pnpm lint:actions
scripts.lint:actions:security: sh -c 'if command -v zizmor >/dev/null; then zizmor .github/workflows; else echo "zizmor is not installed (pipx install zizmor); CI runs it"; fi'
